description.pvprating.config.formula.gai: Base rating added to the killer after a valid PvP kill.
description.pvprating.config.formula.los: Base rating subtracted from the victim after a valid PvP death, or used as the base negative value when complete loss is enabled.
description.pvprating.config.formula.kil: Multiplies the killer's current rating and adds that amount to the killer's rating gain.
description.pvprating.config.formula.cla: Multiplies the victim's current rating and adds that amount to the killer's rating gain.
description.pvprating.config.formula.tar: Multiplies the victim's current rating and adds that amount to the rating lost by the victim.
description.pvprating.config.formula.com: When enabled, the victim rating is set to -loss - current rating * target multiplier instead of subtracting that loss from the current rating.
description.pvprating.config.formula.pre: When enabled, rating changes are clamped so a player's rating cannot go below zero.

message.pvprating.command.formula_descri: §ePvPRating§r: Killer gain is gain + killerRating * killerMultiplier + victimRating * claimMultiplier. Victim loss is loss + victimRating * targetMultiplier; completeLoss sets the victim rating to the negative loss formula instead of subtracting it, and preventNegative clamps the final rating at 0.
